narrative.headline: An ambitious but vague simulation bet that needs a named buyer before it can raise.
narrative.general_summary: Mantis is a three person Winter 2026 company that combines language models with physics simulation to turn rare human behavior data into predictive digital twins. The idea is technically deep and the broader category of human simulation attracts investors, but the description names no customer, domain or result. The main risks are an unclear first buyer, hard to validate predictions and slow research heavy sales. The most likely path is a modest seed, if a vertical emerges, followed by a hard Series A.
